visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a tan traditional robe and headpiece. He is seen outdoors on a tiled balcony, coughing into his arm. His face shows distress and squinted eyes. Behind him, urban buildings are visible under an overcast sky. (2) A jump cut shows the same man, now wearing a disheveled black wig and a black mask covering his mouth and nose. He continues to cough and looks around frantically. The lighting is natural but flat due to the clouds. (3) The camera pans to follow another man from behind. He wears a white robe and has long black hair tied back. One of his sleeves is empty and tucked into his belt. He is walking away on the balcony. (4) The man in brown approaches the man in white. The man in white turns around, revealing his face; he has two large pieces of white tissue stuffed into his nostrils, making a comical expression. (5) The scene shifts indoors to a bright living room. The man in white stands next to a white Philips appliance (dehumidifier). He points to its circular blue light indicator. The camera zooms in on the control panel which has digital numbers and touch buttons. (6) A series of close-ups show the appliance's features: a water tank being pulled out by hand, the wheels on the bottom moving on the floor, and the man in brown crouching to inspect the machine. (7) The man in white then presents a second, taller cylindrical white appliance (air purifier). He demonstrates its lightness by picking it up and moving it. Overlays with text and icons (dust, bacteria) appear and disappear around him. (8) The final sequence features both men in front of the two machines. They are gesturing towards the camera and the products with enthusiastic facial expressions. Numerous text boxes with promotional prices and dates are displayed across the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tension orchestral music with prominent string sections begins immediately. A male voice speaks in a loud, exaggeratedly dramatic and rasping tone, frequently interrupted by heavy coughing sounds. The acoustic environment has a slight outdoor reverb. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transitions the audio. The dramatic voice continues, calling out for a hero. The BGM maintains its epic, cinematic intensity with percussive hits. (3) A second male voice enters, speaking with a calm, resonant, and slightly theatrical tone. The transition is marked by a subtle shift in the BGM's pitch. (4) A comedic 'boing' or impact SFX occurs as the first voice expresses shock. The BGM suddenly stops, creating a brief moment of strategic silence before a 'sniffing' sound is heard. (5) The BGM transitions into a high-tempo, upbeat pop-electronic track with a steady drum beat. The second male voice now speaks in a clear, fast-paced, and professional promotional tone, emphasizing brand names and technical specifications. (6) Distinct post-production SFX, including 'dings,' digital 'beeps,' and 'pop' sounds, are synchronized with the description of various product features. The sound of a water tank sliding is audible. (7) The voice density increases as the speaker lists prices and dates. The background music swells slightly in volume but stays behind the clear, well-enunciated narration. A final energetic 'whoosh' and a cheerful musical sting conclude the audio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Philips home appliances (dehumidifier and air purifier) through a comedic skit parodying a famous wuxia character ('Yang Guo'), highlighting the products' effectiveness against humidity and allergies.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, mention of brand name (Philips), and listing of promotional prices and platforms (MOMO).
